hero.bio: Software developer focused on modern, scalable ecosystems with React, TypeScript, Supabase, and Vercel. Merging minimalist aesthetics, intuitive Figma designs, and solid engineering.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Combining engineering rigor, Figma UI/UX, and modernist aesthetics.
about.p1: With a strong background in web application engineering, I architect and deliver complete applications — from fluid, reactive frontend interfaces to scalable cloud backends powered by Supabase, PostgreSQL, and continuous deployment on Vercel.
about.p2: My technical specialization moves naturally between modern React with TypeScript, Angular, and the cloud power of Supabase (Authentication, Relational Databases, and Edge Functions). I champion Clean Architecture, intuitive UI/UX with Figma, and automated testing.
about.p3: I believe true modern design thrives in clarity: clean interfaces, purposeful typography, and uncompromised code maintainability.
